source_policy: Public claims are recorded as competitor claims unless independently verified. P2GC must not repeat them as its own proof.

findings.observation: Uses a free 13-question GSA readiness assessment plus ROI and pricing tools as low-friction entry points before consultation.
findings.p2gc_action: Make Federal Pathway Score the primary diagnostic entry point and expose a fast result before asking for a meeting.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: A visible Federal Pathway Score CTA will generate more diagnostic completions and qualified meetings than a generic consultation CTA.

findings.observation: Publishes fixed-fee GSA application price ranges and a starting monthly maintenance price.
findings.p2gc_action: Test a transparent starting investment anchor on one landing page without changing approved pricing floors.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: A starting-investment anchor may improve qualified conversion by reducing uncertainty while filtering poor-fit buyers.

findings.observation: Packages market intelligence, capability materials, outreach and coaching into a named Marketing Action Plan with an explicit package price.
findings.p2gc_action: Keep front-door offers productized and named; sell an outcome and defined deliverable rather than a broad consulting menu.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: Named diagnostic offers with explicit deliverables will outperform broad GovCon consulting positioning.

findings.observation: Offers a low-cost monthly market-intelligence subscription with buyer, competitor, opportunity and AI analysis features.
findings.p2gc_action: Do not race to the bottom on software pricing; differentiate P2GC around decision-grade intelligence plus execution and advisory accountability.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: Positioning intelligence as an executive decision system rather than an opportunity database will improve qualified-buyer response.

findings.observation: Uses free checklists for list building and sells a $299/month member intelligence database featuring opportunities, contracting officer contacts, primes, expiring contracts and awards.
findings.p2gc_action: Test one downloadable evidence-backed checklist beneath the Federal Pathway Score for prospects not ready to complete a diagnostic.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: A useful checklist secondary conversion path will capture non-ready visitors without diluting the primary diagnostic CTA.

findings.observation: Bundles marketing, consulting and proposal support into a six-month flagship program and uses a free market assessment as the entry CTA.
findings.p2gc_action: Preserve a simple diagnostic-to-paid-path-to-recurring-support ladder rather than exposing the full service catalog at first contact.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: A three-step diagnostic → paid activation → recurring growth path will convert better than a service-menu funnel.

findings.observation: Publishes timely posts tied to current acquisition changes and converts those updates into assessment calls.
findings.p2gc_action: Prioritize timely data-backed GovCon change posts inside the founder authority cadence and link each to one diagnostic CTA.
findings.experiment_hypothesis: Timely acquisition-change content will create more diagnostic starts than evergreen generic GovCon tips.

findings.observation: Places multiple large quantified proof claims prominently above the fold.
findings.p2gc_action: Do not answer competitor proof density with unverified claims. Build a smaller evidence-backed proof library and visibly distinguish verified results from methodology.
